caption: The drawing features a landscape scene with a mix of architectural structures, natural elements, and human figures. In the foreground on the left, there is a large tree with long, dark green hanging moss or branches, behind which stands a woman dressed in a voluminous, dark dress with white trim and a wide-brimmed hat, accompanied by another smaller figure in a green dress. In front of the tree, there is a stone monument with engraved text, surrounded by green and yellow foliage. To the right, there is a small body of water with white swans swimming. In the middle ground, there is a path or road leading to a cluster of buildings, including a central structure with a dome and another large building with columns and a red roof. Scattered around are green lawns and bushes. The background features a body of water with sailing boats and a pastel sky with bands of blue, pink, yellow, and gray clouds. The entire scene is framed with a wide, off-white border.
title: Memorial Painting
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
